name: subagents-tab-view
description: A panel of your subagents with model, context, cost and time, a per-agent Steps accordion, and a crab whose costume follows the model. Fork of the agents panel from JohnnyVizz/claude-kit (MIT).

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: plan: when a plan is reported to the progress bar; any: also when any subagent starts

stepsFor.title: Ask subagents for step reports
stepsFor.description: all: every subagent is asked to report its steps, which feeds the Steps accordion; off: never
